index.desc: Forget ordinary word lists. Transform language learning into a fun adventure with gamified trainings, daily streaks, and performance analytics.
index.card1.title: Training Like a Game
index.card1.desc: Study words without getting bored like playing a game with reinforcement, exploration expeditions, and fail dungeon modes.
index.card2.title: Detailed Performance Analysis
index.card2.desc: See which words you struggle with and track the exact number of words etched into your memory in real-time.
index.card3.title: Keep Your Streak
index.card3.desc: Grow your streak by practicing regularly every day, and make language learning a habit with daily goals.

training.submode.initial.title: Placement Training
training.submode.initial.text: Since this is your first time logging in, we have prepared a special 30-word test for you. We are measuring your word level with this test!
training.submode.standard.title: Standard Training
training.submode.standard.text: Do a general practice with words best suited to your current level; keep your knowledge fresh with words you've seen before or brand new ones!
training.submode.explore.title: Explore Mode
training.submode.explore.text: Discover brand new words, expand your vocabulary, and learn different terms.
training.submode.mistakes.title: Most Mistaken Words
training.submode.mistakes.text: Review the words you struggle with the most and turn your weak points into advantages!
training.submode.reinforce.title: Reinforcement Study
training.submode.reinforce.text: Strengthen your memory by repeating words that need more practice.
